rv.q: The resulting tragedy has a snarling, pent-up energy.
Engaging, deliberately paced take on the classic study of class conflict and cruelty
Marber’s reimagining may be the best of them all, its psychosexual dynamics teetering on a 70 minutes long tightrope.

Despite the sharp ideas and careful design, Marber’s building on Strindberg’s foundations feels incomplete here. When the tensions fail to ignite, the emotional core remains hidden, leaving a sense of promise unfulfilled.
In just under seventy minutes, this production delivered a textbook lesson in precision.
